output.answer: Yes. Walmart has announced multiple rounds of layoffs and role eliminations, most recently in October 2026, when it confirmed more than 560 Bay Area corporate positions (388 at its San Bruno e-commerce hub and 180 in Sunnyvale) would be cut, on top of a Fremont store closure affecting 169 jobs. Earlier in 2026, in May, Walmart eliminated 1,000 roles — largely in global technology — as it simplified its operating structure under new CEO John Furner, with many affected staff asked to relocate to Bentonville or Northern California. These followed a May 2025 announcement of about 1,500 job cuts across global technology, U.S. e-commerce fulfillment and the Walmart Connect advertising business, plus a July 2025 restructuring that eliminated hundreds of store-support and training roles.
caveats: Walmart frames these actions as restructuring and role 'elimination or relocation' rather than a single mass-layoff announcement, and says many affected employees can transfer to other roles internally or are asked to relocate; the net headcount reduction may be smaller than the gross figures.
The 1,000-role figure in May 2026 comes from a source familiar with the matter speaking to Reuters (via CNBC), not an official Walmart statement with an exact count.
The Bay Area figures come from state WARN regulatory filings reported by a secondary outlet; exact timing and the final number of employees who leave versus relocate or transfer may differ.

Smaller restructurings (e.g., the optical business, store-support roles) were described in internal memos and local reporting; Walmart has not published a consolidated total of jobs affected across 2025-2026.

passages.quote:
Walmart will eliminate more than 560 positions across two Bay Area offices this August, marking one of the retailer’s largest regional workforce reductions since the pandemic reshaped its corporate footprint.

The cuts hit hardest at the company’s San Bruno e-commerce hub, where 388 workers received permanent layoff notices. Another 180 employees at the Sunnyvale office face the same fate starting Aug. 9, according to state regulatory filings.

The corporate restructuring arrives just days before another Bay Area blow. Walmart will shutter its Fremont retail store this Friday, eliminating 169 additional jobs in the East Bay. When combined, the company’s Bay Area workforce will shrink by roughly 730 positions within a single week.
[Walmart](https://www.cnbc.com/quotes/WMT/) has eliminated 1,000 roles as the world's largest retailer simplifies its operating structure, a ⁠source familiar with the matter told Reuters.

May 21 (Reuters) - U.S. retail bellwether Walmart [(WMT.N), opens new tab](https://www.reuters.com/markets/companies/WMT.N) is planning to cut about 1,500 jobs as part of a restructuring push to simplify its operations, according to a memo seen by Reuters.

The company's plan will impact teams in its global technology operations, e-commerce fulfillment in U.S. stores and its advertising business Walmart Connect.

The U.S. retail bellwether is eliminating the market coordinator position, Walmart U.S. executive vice president of store operations, Cedric Clark, told employees in a memo sent on Wednesday. The role helps co-ordinate data compilation and analysis on behalf of some managers.
